verdict.rationale: Sentry's Seer/Autofix is documented as a debugging agent that can 'root-cause' issues, generate fixes, and act as a 'code reviewer' (sentry-docs-2, sentry-docs-13, sentry-docs-26, sentry-docs-27), suggesting AI-driven fix generation, but the evidence never explicitly confirms it opens a pull request against the user's repo for review. missing for 10: explicit documentation/demo of Seer opening a PR against a connected repo, independent confirmation of this PR workflow.
